messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — service=autoscaler region=gcp-us-west2 severity=high
incident-bot: symptom=GPU attach failing; pending queue > 6.4k; error=QUOTA_EXCEEDED (projects/redwood-prod/regions/us-west2/quotas/GPUS)

olivia (oncall): acked. tagging infra + runtime. starting triage.
sam (sre): ack. is this sustained traffic or a job spike?
mike (infra): looks like a mix. sustained steady load plus a burst from bulk-embed pipeline. GCP rejecting new GPU attaches: 

emma (eng-runtime): saw repeated errors in autoscaler logs: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T18:02:12Z cloudprovider: InsertInstance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for 'projects/redwood-prod' and region 'us-west2'. quotaExceeded
```

emma (eng-runtime): autoscaler is in backoff; nodes are not provisioning. current state: scalehold.

olivia (oncall): customer impact? nina — any live customer reports?
nina (cust-success): seeing 7 support threads mentioning high latency; two customers saw request timeouts >45s. No full outages yet. Sending proactive comms.
luis (product): can we deprioritize batch/bulk embed jobs immediately? protect interactive.
sam (sre): yes. recommend ingress throttling and priority sharding. emma, can runtime mark bulk jobs best-effort and apply token-based shedding?

emma (eng-runtime): initiating priority change now. applying route override to label pipeline bulk-embed-prod as low-priority and cap tokens.
```
# temporary route patch
routes["bulk-embed-prod"].priority = "low"
routing.max_concurrent_low_priority = 50
```

mike (infra): parallel actions: open emergency quota request (ticket 4287651), and prepare cross-region reroute + temporary smaller-instance fallback.
mike (infra): emergency request opened: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?project=redwood-prod ref=4287651 — GCP ETA ~ 60-120m per support note.

olivia (oncall): need 0-30m mitigations. Sam, can we reroute some interactive traffic to other regions?
sam (sre): rolling 30% -> us-central1 and 20% -> us-east1 for interactive-tagged requests. applying gradually to avoid sudden latencies.

emma (eng-runtime): enabling model-fallback and quantized variants in-region to reduce GPU per-request footprint. also enabling CPU fallback for background batch tasks.
```
models.fallback = {"/v1/generate": ["gptx-70b-quant", "llama2-7b-q8"]}
```

mike (infra): toggling autoscaler instance profile to allow 1xA10 nodes (n1-standard-16 + a10) temporarily to fit within quota slices instead of 2xA100s. Will affect throughput/latency.
emma (eng-runtime): noted — updating dashboard to reflect expected P50 increase and marking affected requests.
nina (cust-success): posting proactive customer note: "We are experiencing regional GPU provisioning limits causing elevated latency. Engineers have applied traffic shaping and fallbacks. Updates every 30m." :loudspeaker:
luis (product): set expectations: degraded performance but service remains available. prepare post-incident metrics capture.
sam (sre): quick health after initial mitigations:
- interactive P50 latency: +35% (degraded but under emergency threshold)
- queue depth: 6.4k -> 1.9k after priority routing + reroute
- autoscaler: still hitting quota errors for new creates in us-west2

cloud-support-bot: Support ticket 4287651 updated: "Emergency quota request received. Under review by quota team. Please attach usage justification." link: https://support.google.com/cloud/4287651 :white_check_mark:

olivia (oncall): action items recap:
- sam: maintain reroute ratios and observe latency (in progress)
- emma: complete fallback rollout and ensure low-priority queue does not starve interactive (in progress)
- mike: follow up with GCP support and evaluate org-level vs project-level quota; prepare alternative project mapping if required (investigating)
- nina: customer comms every 30m; escalate on timeouts
- luis: flag revenue-impact metrics for data team

sam (sre): extra quick win: enable session-affinity sticky routing to keep warm sessions on existing nodes and reduce churn. deploying now.
emma (eng-runtime): affinity deployed; attach attempts down ~25%.
mike (infra): found contributing factor: an internal bulk ingestion job scheduled at peak pushed expected GPU usage above planning by ~9%. I'll move that job to night window and throttle immediate ingestion.

olivia (oncall): if GCP quota ETA > 3h escalate to exec and prepare heavier shedding (60% reduction on bulk pipelines).
sam (sre): posting planned handover to night oncall at 18:45 UTC.
nina (cust-success): first customer comms sent; customers appreciate transparency. collecting affected account IDs for billing/regression analysis.

cloud-support-bot: GCP support reply: "Provisioning team needs justification attachments; provisional uplift possible within 80-140 minutes after approval." reference 4287651.
luis (product): confirm we tag requests for revenue-correlation.
emma (eng-runtime): incident-tagging enabled and sample export written to s3://redwood-incident-8822334455 with request IDs.

olivia (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay online 40 more minutes. Sam if quota not granted by 19:30 UTC escalate to infra lead (mike) -> exec.
sam (sre): will monitor and update every 15.

---
update (18 minutes later)

sam (sre): queue down to ~1.1k. interactive latencies back within emergency SLO for 92% of sessions. autoscaler still shows intermittent quota rejects but at lower rate.
mike (infra): GCP asked for usage graphs; I uploaded sharded traffic charts and a mitigation plan. Support estimates approval in ~70 minutes after review.
nina (cust-success): no new high-severity customer escalations. support queue trending down.
olivia (oncall): continuing to monitor. any new errors?
emma (eng-runtime): seeing CreateInstance errors at a much lower cadence; fallback and reroute proving effective.
sam (sre): next update in 20 min or on demand. :hourglass:
